correctness.rationale: Pure adjacency/equality rank-four EF types of Q_d reduce, via cube translations and coordinate permutations, to nested SETS of atomic four-tuples indexed by triple coordinate counts c00,c01,c10,c11. Statuses are equality, edge and other nonedge, with repeated vertices allowed. Each class count is safely capped at 4 without changing possible fourth-vertex atomic diagrams: retain at most two 0 and two 1 assignments and lift via an optional at-distance<=1 reference word. Consequently each pair's remaining extension-type set depends on min(h,8) and min(d-h,8), and the root type stabilizes for all d>=16. An independent exact implementation of the coordinate-count extension recursion produced six classes for dimensions 1..16: five singletons {1}..{5} and common {6,...,16}; the two proven cap lemmas, not just this finite census, imply all d>=6 share the sixth four-round theory. The smallest representative of that class has 2^6=64 vertices. Claims restricted to d>=1 and rank 4 pure adjacency without counting.
